blogPosts.metaDescription: How zzai zzai wires Google AdSense: ca-pub verification script, ads.txt, Consent Mode v2, and when you still need display slot IDs for Klean Sneaks.
blogPosts.content:
AdSense on zzaizzai.com

Google AdSense on zzaizzai.com is set up for site verification and Auto ads via the standard adsbygoogle.js snippet in the site layout, plus a matching /ads.txt line for publisher pub-3958850022852446.

What already works without extra keys

  • Site ownership — the async AdSense script in <head> satisfies Google's verification crawler.
  • Auto ads — once your account is approved and Auto ads are enabled in AdSense, Google can place ads without you pasting slot numbers on every page.
  • Consent Mode v2 — default consent loads before Analytics and AdSense so Funding Choices (Three-Choice CMP) can unlock EEA traffic.

When you need slot IDs

In-game placements in Klean Sneaks use explicit display units. Paste banner, interstitial, and rewarded slot numbers in Orbit → AdSense (Platform Secrets) or set NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_SLOT_* in Vercel. Until slots exist, the game silently skips empty ad units — visitors are not shown broken placeholders.

Checklist

  1. Confirm /ads.txt lists your pub id.
  2. Enable Auto ads in AdSense → Sites → zzaizzai.com.
  3. Finish Privacy & messaging (CMP) in AdSense and link your privacy policy.
  4. Add display slot IDs for Klean Sneaks if you want guaranteed in-game units.

blogPosts.content:
Technical SEO checklist

Search engines reward clear URLs, not raw page count. This is how zzai zzai keeps sitemap.xml honest while still shipping many tool and marketing surfaces.

Crawl basics

  • robots.txt allows public hubs and blocks dashboards, APIs, and play-test routes.
  • Sitemap lists quality-filtered URLs — thin or duplicate SEO rows are dropped or unpublished.
  • Canonical tags are set per route via buildSeoMetadata, not one global homepage canonical on every URL.

Indexing beyond Google

IndexNow pings Bing and partners when Orbit publishes or repairs content. Pair that with Google Search Console sitemap submission for coverage you can measure.

Quality over doorways

Near-duplicate SEO landing pages trigger monitor alerts and waste crawl budget. Orbit's traffic-quality repair expands thin copy, heals internal links, and unpublishes redundant clusters so one strong URL ranks.
